os_type.title: ### `os_type` scalar value
os_type.info:
Operating system type.

0 = Windows

1 = macOS (pre v7.70)

2 = Linux (pre v7.70)

On v7.71+, 0 is returned for all platforms unless the theme specifies `want_os_type 1` in rtconfig.txt. In that case, macOS = 3 and Linux = 4.

v7.70 always reports 3 for macOS and 4 for Linux.

folderstate.title: ### `folderstate` scalar value
folderstate.info:
Folder state of track, if applicable.

0 = normal

-n = last track in folder(s).

folderdepth.title: ### `folderdepth` scalar value
folderdepth.info:
Indicates how many folders deep.

Positive if in a folder.

maxfolderdepth.title: ### `maxfolderdepth` scalar value
maxfolderdepth.info: Highest folder depth of any track.

mcp_maxfolderdepth.title: ### `mcp_maxfolderdepth` scalar value
mcp_maxfolderdepth.info: Highest folder depth of any track in the mixer.

recarm.title: ### `recarm` scalar value
recarm.info: Nonzero if track is record armed.

tcp_iconsize.title: ### `tcp_iconsize` scalar value
tcp_iconsize.info: Size of track panel icon column, if any.

mcp_iconsize.title: ### `mcp_iconsize` scalar value
mcp_iconsize.info: Size of mixer icon row, if any.

mcp_wantextmix.title: ### `mcp_wantextmix` scalar value
mcp_wantextmix.info:
Flags indicating which extended mixer settings are desired.

&1 = inserts

&2 = sends

&4 = FX parameters.

trackpanmode.title: ### `trackpanmode` scalar value
trackpanmode.info:
Pan mode of track.

0 = classic 3.x

3 = new balance

5 = stereo pan

6 = dual pan.

tcp_fxparms.title: ### `tcp_fxparms` scalar value
tcp_fxparms.info: Count of TCP FX parameters visible (0-n), including sends or FX items if visible.

tcp_fxembed.title: ### `tcp_fxembed` scalar value
tcp_fxembed.info: Count of TCP embedded FX visible.

mcp_fxembed.title: ### `mcp_fxembed` scalar value
mcp_fxembed.info: Count of MCP embedded FX visible.

tcp_sends_enabled.title: ### `tcp_sends_enabled` scalar value
tcp_sends_enabled.info: User preference to show sends in TCP is enabled.

tcp_fxlist_enabled.title: ### `tcp_fxlist_enabled` scalar value
tcp_fxlist_enabled.info: User preference to show FX inserts in TCP is enabled.

trackpinned.title: ### `trackpinned` scalar value
trackpinned.info:
TCP-pinned state.

1 = pinned, but globally disabled

2 = pinned.

tcp_hidden_overridden.title: ### `tcp_hidden_overridden` scalar value
tcp_hidden_overridden.info: 1 if track is marked hidden in TCP but being displayed due to global override.

trackcolor_valid.title: ### `trackcolor_valid` scalar value
trackcolor_valid.info: Set to 1 if track color is set.

trackcolor_r.title: ### `trackcolor_r` scalar value
trackcolor_r.info:
Red value, 0-255.

Valid if `trackcolor_valid` is set.

trackcolor_g.title: ### `trackcolor_g` scalar value
trackcolor_g.info:
Green value, 0-255.

Valid if `trackcolor_valid` is set.

trackcolor_b.title: ### `trackcolor_b` scalar value
trackcolor_b.info:
Blue value, 0-255.

Valid if `trackcolor_valid` is set.

mixer_visible.title: ### `mixer_visible` scalar value
mixer_visible.info: Set to 1 if the mixer is visible.

track_selected.title: ### `track_selected` scalar value
track_selected.info: Set to 1 if track is selected.

ntracks.title: ### `ntracks` scalar value
ntracks.info: Total track count, not including master.

trans_flags.title: ### `trans_flags` scalar value
trans_flags.info:
Transport display flags.

`trans_flags&1` is nonzero if transport is centered.

`trans_flags&2` is nonzero if user wants play speed controls visible.

`trans_flags&4` is nonzero if user wants current time signature visible.

envcp_type.title: ### `envcp_type` scalar value
envcp_type.info: 4 if FX envelope, which can display additional controls.

env_selected.title: ### `env_selected` scalar value
env_selected.info: Set to 1 if envelope is selected.
